timing_scope: Complete sources were read immediately before receipt preparation. These timestamps anchor final hash/AST/census binding, not an invented earlier reading start.
independence: Independent of parent-authored helper adaptations. Authored electrical-cable-recycling-residues; this is operational review, not scientific acceptance of that owner.
counts_status: Provisional: configuration forecasts514 reviews; current510 includes this reviewer save, with four other final scientific saves pending. Exact runtime count/coverage verification must precede publication.
observations: Read all three scripts; exact round/base-only substitution against retained round90 originals verified, and AST parsed without top-level execution.

Isolated verification refuses existing output/clone paths and reads the source checkout. Synthetic index/commit changes occur only in a new clone of main plus tags. Retained tag object and peeled target are checked locally/remotely; topic-object absence is tested three times.

Preflight binds clean source head/tree and trusted remote main, then constructs exact-tree single-parent squash analogue. Postmerge requires owned local/remote topic absence, actual main/tree and exactly one trusted-base parent. Strict records, history, canonical review and current-hash coverage run in the fresh clone; final tree/cleanliness checks remain.

Coverage uses hidden/ignored-inclusive followed directory enumeration with cycle prevention; a positive completed scientific review must match owner ID/path/current SHA and reviewed_target_ids. Every review base must exist as a commit. Canonical checker supplies schema/lineage enforcement separately.

Enqueue binds successful preflight mode/head/tree/base/log/required commands/counts, clean source head, live PR branch/base/title/body, complete paginated changed path set, required validate-strict success and exact posted COMMENT at reviewed head. SQUASH/ALLGREEN queue rules and required context are checked; immediate live-main read precedes match-head-commit admission.
limitations: No top-level helper, clone, network request or Git/GitHub mutation was executed for this review. Runtime preflight and publication receipts remain necessary.

No repeated full suite runs in the isolated helper. Final publication must separately bind the actual final local just check receipt to the reviewed package; its source comment is not proof of a future pass.

Scientific independence, source support and corrective lineage require independent scientific/package reviews; exact hosted blobs and CI workflow/run/job identity require hosted audit beyond the enqueue path check.

The first100 posted reviews are read by enqueue. A matching comment only on a later page would fail closed, not admit a mismatched review; this current bounded cohort does not call for a behavior change.
Live main read is not atomic locking. Native merge-group and actual merged parent/tree plus fresh-main provenance verification remain required.

Current census is435/497/510/92; configured514reviews and435coverage are future expected values. No final count, full coverage or batch success is claimed here. Subsequent helper/config changes require rebinding.
